svg.title: All three terms are required to decode the sum of squares
svg.desc: For the fixed six-record dataset, decoding x equals forty plus two u uses six codes with sum six and sum of squares twenty-four. The recovered total is six times forty plus two times six, two hundred fifty-two. The sum of raw squares has three contributions: six times forty squared is nine thousand six hundred; the cross term two times forty times two times six is nine hundred sixty; and two squared times twenty-four is ninety-six. Together they give ten thousand six hundred fifty-six. The recovered mean is forty-two and population variance twelve. With the alternative origin forty-four and the same scale two, the coded sum is minus six and coded sum of squares remains twenty-four. The contributions become eleven thousand six hundred sixteen, minus one thousand fifty-six and ninety-six, with the same recovered sum ten thousand six hundred fifty-six. The sign of the cross term must be retained.
